outcomes.description: Move the book behind the flower, including the requested relative depth ordering.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what change, if any, is visible in the placement of the same book relative to the same flower?
nodes.criteria: complete: the book is visibly behind the flower in the edited image, with clear depth ordering such as the flower occluding the book. partial: the book has been repositioned in a way that visibly advances it toward being behind the flower, even if the depth ordering is not yet complete; mere proximity or movement toward the flower without evidence of advancing the behind relation is not progress. absent: no visible progress toward placing the book behind the flower. Ignore unrelated changes to the book or flowers. unknown: evidence is insufficient to compare the objects or determine progress.
nodes.binding: Source and edited images: identify the book and flower in the source, then compare those same objects in the edited image. Assess the book's placement and depth ordering relative to the flower.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
